statements.t: While spending on public infrastructure and large private non-residential construction projects continued to support demand for our Heavy Materials products, elevated interest rates placed additional pressure on an already challenging residential construction market.

Corporate General and Administrative Expenses during the second quarter increased 26% primarily because of increased health insurance costs and costs associated with implementing our new enterprise resource planning system, which is expected to continue in future quarters as the system is implemented across the remaining businesses.

For example, increases in interest rates, decreases in demand for construction materials or increases in the cost of our raw materials can be expected to adversely affect the revenue and operating earnings of our operations.

risks.t: the following: the cyclical and seasonal nature of the Company’s businesses
the effects of adverse weather conditions on infrastructure and other construction projects as well as our facilities and operations
the availability of and fluctuations in the cost of raw materials
changes in the cost and availability of transportation
unexpected operational difficulties, including unexpected maintenance costs, equipment downtime and interruption of production
material nonpayment or non-performance by any of our key customers
difficulties and delays in the development of new business lines
governmental regulation and changes in governmental and public policy (including, without limitation, climate change and other environmental regulation)
possible losses or other adverse outcomes from pending or future litigation or arbitration proceedings
increases in capacity in the gypsum wallboard and cement industries
changes in the demand for residential housing construction or commercial construction or construction projects undertaken by state or local governments
the availability of acquisitions or other growth opportunities that meet our financial return standards and fit our strategic focus
general economic conditions, including inflation and recessionary conditions
